plugin.name: MiniMax-H3
plugin.description: Self-hosted MiniMax-H3 33B video generation with native stereo audio (text / first+last frame / multi-image / omni-reference) via headless ComfyUI.

env.description: Hugging Face token (Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 is public; only needed if it becomes gated)
Max seconds to wait for a Modal call
Modal GPU type. B200 (192 GB) keeps both checkpoints resident; on H100/A100 also set H3_TEXT_ENCODER_VARIANT=int8
Text encoder quantization: nvfp4 (Blackwell-native, 15.7 GB) or int8 (27.1 GB, for pre-Blackwell GPUs)
Output canvas short edge in pixels (model native 768). Lower for faster, cheaper drafts
